title: TCP Three-Way Handshake Flags
statement: What is the correct sequence of control flags exchanged between client and server during the establishment of a standard TCP connection?
explanation: TCP 3-way handshake: 1. Client sends SYN (Synchronize Sequence Number). 2. Server responds with SYN-ACK. 3. Client acknowledges with ACK.

title: CIDR Subnet Mask and Usable Host Count
statement: How many usable host IP addresses are available in a subnet with a CIDR prefix of /27?
explanation: A /27 subnet has 32 - 27 = 5 host bits. Total IP addresses = 2^5 = 32. Subtracting 2 reserved addresses (1 for Network Address and 1 for Broadcast Address) gives 32 - 2 = 30 usable host IPs.

title: DNS Protocol Port and Transport Layer
statement: Which transport layer protocol and default port are primarily used for standard DNS query resolution?
explanation: Standard DNS lookups use UDP port 53 because of low latency and minimal overhead. TCP port 53 is reserved for zone transfers and queries exceeding 512 bytes.
